tts_lines: Dumbbell lateral raise. Avoid flaring straight out and pinching your shoulder joint.
Shrugging the weights up overloads your upper traps instead of your side delts.
Depress your shoulder blades and lock your shoulder joint in a safe groove.
Raise thirty degrees forward in the scapular plane to fire your lateral deltoid fibers.
caption:
Dumbbell lateral raise: wrong vs right in 20 seconds.
WRONG: flaring straight up to 118° pinches the shoulder joint and shrugs the traps.
RIGHT: shoulder blades down, raise 30° forward in the scapular plane to load the side delts.
Save this for your next shoulder day.
